ios.desc:
Watch bizarre AI-generated clips and guess the legendary films that inspired them.
Every level gets harder. Every clip is weirder. Can you keep up?
New clips added regularly — the ultimate daily challenge for movie buffs.

You talkin' to me, movie buff? Then show me the money as you watch AI-created clips and guess which legendary films inspired them. Nobody puts Baby in a corner, and we certainly don't put passionate cinema lovers there either.

Life is like a box of chocolates in this game because you never know which iconic movie moment you're gonna encounter next. Feel the need, the need for speed as you race through increasingly challenging levels that will test even the most dedicated film enthusiast.

Houston, we have a problem if you think you can handle the truth about your movie expertise without breaking a sweat. But don't worry because I'll be back with regular updates to keep this excellent adventure fresh and endlessly entertaining.

When it comes to movie trivia games, nobody does it better than this ultimate cinematic challenge!

EULA: https://indest.ee/eula/
